profile.headline: Software Developer Engineer at Preh Group
profile.summary:
Highly skilled embedded software engineer with extensive experience in automotive systems development, specializing in AUTOSAR-based solutions, embedded software architecture, and automotive communication protocols. Adept at driving innovation through real-time embedded systems, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and optimizing vehicle performance.
With a strong background in software development and testing, I have successfully collaborated with cross-functional teams to define, implement, and validate software solutions for major OEMs such as Ford, GM, Tesla, and Lucid. My expertise in CAN, LIN, I2C, and Ethernet protocols allows me to design robust and scalable software solutions that enhance functionality and reliability in modern vehicles.
Additionally, I excel in debugging and troubleshooting embedded controllers, leveraging advanced tools like Lauterbach Trace32, Polyspace, Razorcat Tessy, and Vector CANoe to ensure software integrity. My experience with MATLAB System Composer enables me to model and simulate complex automotive systems, driving efficiency in software development and integration.
I thrive in agile development environments, leveraging CI/CD pipelines, IBM DOORS, and JIRA to streamline software delivery while maintaining quality and compliance with V-Cycle and automotive industry best practices. As a key technical contact at GM, I have facilitated global collaboration, ensuring alignment across Preh’s international locations.
Passionate about embedded technology, vehicle tuning, and automotive innovation, I am eager to contribute my skills to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of mobility.
